utterances.text: Hello there! How was your day?
Hey Grandpa! My day was pretty good, just busy with schoolwork.
Ah, I see. Well, once you get it, you'll have more freedom to go places. Do you need any help with the process?
Thanks, Grandpa! I think I'm good for now, but I'll let you know if I need anything.
I'm sorry if I made you feel that way. I didn't mean to group you with anyone else. You're doing great, and I'm here to help you.
No worries, Grandpa. I know you didn't mean it that way. I appreciate your support.
No, you're not scaring me at all. I'm just here to support you.
Thanks, Grandpa. I really appreciate you being there for me.
No, you're not scaring me at all. I'm just here to support you.
I'm glad we understand each other. It's nice to have your support.
You're doing really well for your first time. Keep it up!
Thanks, Grandpa! That means a lot to me.
I'm glad to hear that. If you need any advice or help, just let me know.
I will, Grandpa. Thanks for always being there for me.
Sounds like you're having a good time with the trucks. What do you like most about driving them?
I love the freedom it gives me, and it's exciting to explore new places.
Robbie's truck must be quite impressive. Do you enjoy driving it more than your own?
Yeah, it's a great truck, but I think I still prefer mine because I'm more used to it.
It sounds like you have quite a few friends with trucks. Do you all go on adventures together?
Yeah, we do! It's always fun to hit the road and see where we end up.
Yes, right here. We can talk about it or plan something fun with your friends and their trucks.
That sounds awesome! Maybe we can plan a camping trip or something.
